# External validation: CLEF TAR 2019 (Intervention, 20 Cochrane reviews)

Generated by `benchmark/external/evaluate.py`; plan fixed beforehand in `PLAN.md`. Do not edit by hand.

- CLEF TAR commit `dbc13d02bb3e`; up to 1,000 records per review (every include kept, the rest a weighted sample)
- 41,996 records in the 20 reviews, 13,637 asked, 510 final includes (937 title/abstract includes); 18 reviews have at least one final include
- Thresholds from SYNERGY+, not retuned: 0.06 (safe, frozen), 0.08 (safe, corrected), 0.17 (98%, frozen), 0.26 (95%, frozen)
- Model jev-1.13.0, 13,637 calls, US$ 0.595; answers sha256 `bd5a385634a8`
- Records without an abstract or not in PubMed (never below the threshold): 719 asked records, 34 of them final includes

## Secondary

- Score alone (no abstract rule) at 0.06: pooled recall 100.0%, reviews keeping every include 18/18
- Title/abstract includes kept at 0.06: 99.7% pooled, lowest review 96%
- Ranking (weighted): median WSS@95 0.889, median WSS@100 0.936, median AUC 0.984
- Final includes below 0.06: 0
